_about: B-button press rate of the Contra (NES) Any% No Turbo record (Angrylanks 9:48.183, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YgtFCclM1jM). Measured 2026-10-12 in the built-in browser from the 720p60 stream. See record_mash_rate.md for method, limits and the recommendation. Times are video seconds (run = 12.000 to 600.183). 'Presses' here are button clicks heard on the runner's microphone track that form regular trains; they are a LOWER BOUND on his presses (soft presses and isolated single taps are not in the trains).

handcam.coverage: frames 600-9958 (10-166 s) sampled every 2nd video frame, 120x76 luminance grid of the hands; plus frames 3600-3929 at every frame
handcam.what_it_shows: A ~8.75 Hz tapping is visible in six 2-second windows (spectral peak 8.75 Hz and its 15-fps alias 6.25 Hz, prominence 5 to 18) at 78.5-79.5 s, 95.0-95.5 s and 111.5-112.0 s, where the audio gives 8.8-9.2 presses/s. During 12 Hz trains the handcam shows no usable peak (prominence 1.1-3.7, same as windows with no pressing).

audio_clicks.what: Controller button clicks picked up by the runner's microphone: short broadband transients, 2.8-8.8 kHz. Not game audio: intervals are not multiples of the 16.64 ms NES frame (e.g. 47,49,47,49,50,49,48,47 samples at 600 Hz where frame-locked sound could only give about 40 or 50).
audio_clicks.capture: Web Audio tap on the page's video element, real time, silent (nothing routed to the speakers), 24 kHz mono, 14,213,120 samples for 593.5 s of video (0.22% of samples lost in capture, spread evenly; rates may read up to 0.25% high)
audio_clicks.onset_function: spectral flux of log magnitude, bins 2.8-8.8 kHz, 256-point FFT, 600 values per second, normalised by local median and spread
audio_clicks.train_rule: at least 4 detected clicks with successive intervals 55-135 ms within 25% of the running period; up to 2 consecutive missing clicks are bridged (273 of 2168 presses are bridged, not heard)
audio_clicks.press_vs_release: Each press makes a press click and a weaker release click. Click trains faster than 14.7/s are press+release pairs and are counted at half rate (checked against bullets in the Hangar and against the handcam in Base 1).
audio_clicks.audio_vs_video_offset_frames: +2 to +3 (audio label later than the bullet appearing)

game_picture.what: Space-time diagrams (kymographs) of the centre-line Spread bullets on a dark background; bullets are a lower bound on presses because a press with no free bullet slot shows nothing.

isolated_strong_clicks_not_in_trains.note: upper bound for additional single B taps; includes jump (A) presses and some releases

longest_continuous_stretch_s.note: The Base 2 boss train is 13.07 s long (153 presses, 11.7 /s mean) but dips to 8-10 in three one-second windows; whether those dips are real hesitations or unheard clicks is not known.

loose.note: low threshold; adds many doubtful slow trains, not used

per_second_train_presses.encoding: one character per second starting at video time 12.0 s (589 characters); 0-9, a=10, b=11, c=12, d=13

not_resolved: Soft presses the microphone does not pick up: all totals, fractions and sustained maxima are lower bounds.
Isolated single B taps cannot be told from jump (A) presses in the audio.
Base rooms, both base bosses, the stage 1, 3, 7 bosses and the heart are measured by audio only (bullets vanish at point-blank range).
The handcam cannot show the 12 /s mash at all.
